findings.actual_failure: Six parametrized cases that ran and gated pull requests inside gate-main before the move (the projected-variant half of test_entry_point_imports_under_user_scope_layout, which verifies build-projected skill entry points import cleanly under user-scope layout) now silently skip on every pull request after the move — a check weakened by the move, violating the spec's Never do, its Contract ('no check is added, removed, or weakened'), and its Outcome ('Every check that gated a pull request before the move still runs'). The invocation set is preserved byte-identical, so the loss is invisible to the posture test, the parity lint, and the aggregator.
findings.observation: The sibling job runs 'python -m pytest tests/ -q' in shard-1 with no build step, and dist/ is gitignored (.gitignore:100), so its fresh checkout never has dist/apm/. tests/roster/test_credential_user_scope_invocation.py skips all six 'projected'-variant cases when dist/apm/ is absent (pytest.skip, exit 0, silent under -q). Before the move, gate-main's 'Run make build-check' (base 6dc12944e build-check.yml:231) ran before the carve-out step (base :1085), and make build-check materializes dist/apm/: Makefile:161-166 chains tools/repo/build_gate_chain.py build-check --output-dir dist, whose catalogue-build leg (build_gate_chain.py:236-238) runs 'agentbundle catalogue build --root . --output dist', and the default recipe set (packages/agentbundle/agentbundle/build/main.py:524-543) includes per-pack-apm-package (route apm, output-subdir apm). The ledger excludes dist/apm/ from the probe on the claim 'gate-main does not run make build-self, so the suite skips there today for the same reason' — false: make build-check's catalogue-build leg, not make build-self, is what supplied dist/apm/ inside gate-main.
findings.reachable_path: PR evaluates build-check.yml -> gate-catalogue-tests shard-1 -> dispatch step 'pytest tests/' -> tests/roster/test_credential_user_scope_invocation.py collected -> projected variant sees DIST_APM absent -> pytest.skip x6 -> shard exits green -> aggregator reports success. No gate reddens: the posture test pins the dispatch body's text (not skip outcomes) and the probe (build-check.yml:1664) deliberately does not check dist/apm/.

findings.actual_failure: A runner-image change that drops cat or grep from /usr/bin, /bin, or /usr/local/bin silently weakens the required gate — three promotion-drain tests skip with every check green, the exact silent-skip class the probe exists to convert into a red (the R1-001 class, different dependency). The practical trigger is improbable on today's ubuntu-latest, but the durable record compounds it: the ledger states the probe set is 'the discovered set' when its own complete static scan found more, so a future maintainer extending provisioning relies on a coverage claim the ledger itself contradicts. Repair: cover the recorded cat/grep dependencies in the probe (PINNED_PROBE_BODY and its mutations updated in the same commit per the same-commit rail), or record their exclusion in the ledger's 'Deliberately not probed' list with the reason.
findings.observation: The sibling's probe checks executables 'git sh make node' (.github/workflows/build-check.yml:1683), but the ledger's static scan records 'sh/cat/grep (promotion-drain and shell probes)' as provisioning-relevant skip sites found (verification-ledger.md:82-83) while presenting the probe set as 'the discovered set' (verification-ledger.md:85-87). The promotion-drain skip sites actually guard on 'cat' and 'grep' — tests/roster/test_promotion_drain_envelope.py:139 and :171 skip on 'cat not found in the declared tool locations' and :187 on 'grep not found' — resolved from fixed directories ('/usr/bin', '/bin', '/usr/local/bin', promotion_drain.py:185) against ALLOWLISTED_TOOLS = ('cat', 'wc', 'grep', 'ls') (promotion_drain.py:182); the probed 'sh' is not one of them. The ledger's 'Deliberately not probed' list (verification-ledger.md:88-98) covers only platform skips and dist/apm, so cat/grep appear in neither the probe set nor the not-probed list.
